title: Höpken and Carlson, Constantinople, to the King of Sweden, January 1740: despatch in a second numerical code with the contemporary Swedish decipherment written over it (split from catalogue 1771); transcribed, key not yet built

documents.shelfmark: Stockholm, Riksarkivet, Diplomatica Turcica, SE/RA/2119/2119.1/I/9/21 (image series R0003582), images 322-327
documents.route: Carl Fredrik Höpken and Edvard Carlson, Constantinople -> the King of Sweden

plaintext.source: Contemporary decipherment in Swedish written over the struck-through groups by the chancery decipherer.

transcription.source: Riksarkivet IIIF images, full size (lbiiif.riksarkivet.se, R0003582)
transcription.notes: Pass 1 only, by two AI agents with the Swedish gloss in view; no blind digit-only pass yet. Gloss column rough.

system.summary: Numerical code of four-digit groups seen between about 1004 and 1999, mainly syllables. Different from the code of images 255-261 (groups there stop at 1749; values clash).
system.notes: Seed values read by eye only; no key built.

prior_solution.where: The contemporary Swedish decipherment written over the groups on images 322-327. No edition or modern decipherment found (web searches, 10 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Daniel Bourdeau set the task; AI language-model agents transcribed. No human palaeographer checked the text.

solution.what: Images 322-327 of R0003582 fetched from the Riksarkivet IIIF service at full size.
Pass 1 by two AI agents with the Swedish gloss in view: 123 runs, 2118 groups (pairs_322_324.tsv, pairs_325_327.tsv); 23 runs K. Gloss column rough and loosely aligned.
Groups above 1749 (to about 1999) and value clashes with the French-glossed code of 255-261 show a second code; split from hopken1739.
Hard-EM segmentation on the 23 K runs with 9 seeds: alignments are not usable (gloss extents too loose). Word-level re-pairing started.

outcome.method_basis: Transcribed only; no key built yet.
